THE CHAMPION

❓ HOW TO PLAY · Cách chơi

  1. Two teams, one winner. Blue and Red take turns. / Hai đội thay phiên nhau trả lời, số câu chia đều.
  2. Look at the picture, read the question, tap an answer, then press LOCK IN (or Enter). You cannot change it after locking. / Chọn đáp án rồi bấm LOCK IN.
  3. Scoring: correct = +10 · three correct in a row = +5 · answer in the first 5 seconds = +2.
  4. STEAL POINTS: if a player is wrong or runs out of time, the other team gets a steal chance (+10 and +5 bonus). Not used in Word Matching rounds.
  5. Question types: Multiple Choice, Look and Choose, Fill in the Blank, True or False, Word Matching (tap a picture, then its words), Number Challenge, Order Challenge (tap items in order).
  6. Keyboard: 1 / 2 / 3 or A / B / C choose · Enter lock in · Space next · P pause.
  7. Teachers: choose topic, number of questions, time, steal, sound, shuffle on the home screen. Practice mode = 1 player.
